scenes.name: Crow finds the cheese
scenes.narration: One morning, a crow found a piece of cheese. She flew up into a tall tree.

scenes.name: The fox arrives
scenes.narration: A hungry fox walked by. He saw the cheese. "I want that cheese!" he said.

scenes.name: The fox flatters
scenes.narration: "Hello, Crow!" said the Fox. "Your feathers are so shiny. I think your voice is beautiful too. Please sing for me!"

scenes.name: The crow sings
scenes.narration: The Crow felt very proud. She opened her beak and sang, "Caw! Caw!"

scenes.name: The cheese falls
scenes.narration: The cheese fell down. The Fox caught it and ran away. "Thank you!" he laughed.

scenes.name: Moral
scenes.narration: Moral: Be careful when someone says nice things just to get something from you.

scenes.name: Key words
scenes.narration: crow fox cheese tree feathers beak sing
